about_the_game:
A card game adventure that challenges the mysteries of the Cthulhu Mythos

The rumor is that if you reach the highest rank, you will be able to use magic in the card game Erase. The protagonist, Natsuyagi Uzura, deepens her relationships with her classmates and the townspeople while challenging powerful opponents. Meanwhile, a strange series of suspicious deaths is occurring in the town...

Daily life and story set in the city of Kyoto

The protagonists' area of ​​action is the city of Kyoto.

In the game, you can visit shops and famous places that are actually open in Kyoto.

A deep card game and puzzle system

- Create chains in puzzles to earn card usage costs!Make chains carefully for a big move?Use cards in small chains?Or turn the tables with a combo?There are as many ways to fight as there are decks.

Collect information and cards through growth and exploration

By interacting with other characters in your daily life and learning, the success rate of the protagonist's skills will increase. Let's develop various abilities so that they will be useful when it comes time to explore dangerous places.

The success rate of skills is determined by a simple 1D100 downward roll. If the dice show a number equal to or less than the success rate (%) of the skill, it is a success.

Creeping madness

The closer you get to the abyss, the more crisis there is in the protagonist's mind. If your sanity decreases, you may become insane and be unable to act normally.

They may become paranoid, which can affect their communication, or they may become paralyzed by trauma.

Madness comes with great risks, such as penalties on skill checks and forced rewriting of choices.

Solve the mystery of Erase

In the story, many mysteries stand in your way, centering on the card game "Erase". Examine the information you have obtained and determine what is happening.

Commentary/Streaming Guidelines

Game commentary, streaming, and game introductions are all welcome.

Please abide by the following rules when streaming:

- Include the Steam store page URL for "Erase-missing link-" in the video description.

- please recommend to viewers to purchase "Erase-missing link-" during your video or stream.

- (If possible) please join our Discord server (link on the far right of this page) and post a link to your video in the "ファンアート・動画等" channel. *This field is optional.

content_descriptors.notes: Contains depictions of smoking, drinking, swearing, injuries, bloodshed, violence, murder, etc. The depictions are at the level of a typical mystery novel or hard-boiled novel, and do not contain overly graphic content.

short_description: A Tabletop role-playing game-style card game adventure that delves into the mysteries of the Cthulhu Mythos. You play card games, grow your skills by interacting with people, get information by exploring, and solve the mythical incidents by unraveling the secrets hidden in the cards.
